coffee.help: Only days you answered in Som's café count. A pattern, not a cause.

night.offer: It's Down Time. Ready to close today and plan tomorrow?

night.unsaved: Tomorrow's plan isn't saved yet. Check your connection, then tap Goodnight again.
night.late: Done. The Night ticket counts until 3 h before your wake-up.
night.seedsHint: Tap a seed to plant it in every empty plot ({n}).

night.bedLater: Sleep starts at {time}. When you lie down, tap Going to bed on Today.
night.examTomorrow: Exam tomorrow. Som says: get a full night's sleep.
night.examDone: You did the exam today. Som is proud; rest well.

somMeets.chicken: The chick hides behind Som, then peeks out.
somMeets.duck: The duckling follows Som everywhere. Som pretends not to mind.
somMeets.golden_goose: Som stares at the shiny goose. The goose stares back.
somMeets.bunny: Som and the bunny touch noses. Friends.
somMeets.cow: The calf licks Som's head. Som is now very wet.
somMeets.sheep: Som naps on the lamb's soft wool.
somMeets.pig: The piglet steals Som's cushion. Som lets it.
somMeets.cat: Another cat? Som sniffs, then shares the sunny spot.
somMeets.dog: The pup wants to play. Som climbs a fence post to think about it.
somMeets.goat: The kid tries to nibble Som's tail. Som is not amused.
somMeets.capybara: Som sits on the capybara. The capybara doesn't mind at all.
somMeets.alpaca: Som disappears into the alpaca's fluff.
somMeets.red_panda: Som and the red panda compare tails. It's a tie.

tips.label: Tip
tips.title: Tips
tips.moreHint: Small hints that show the first time you meet a feature.

text.wake: Tap "I'm up" the moment you leave the bed. Inside your window it earns a Sunrise ticket.
text.first10: This is the block you're in. Start it, then do its first 10 minutes: the smallest step in.
text.night: Before bed, the Night ritual closes today and plans tomorrow. It earns a Night ticket.
text.exercise: Log any workout of 10 minutes or more. It feeds your animals, and every 3rd one hatches an egg.
text.streak: Your streak: an "I'm up" in your window plus the Night ritual keeps it going. Scarecrows save a missed day.
text.plan: Plan any day here. Changes you make for one day never touch your usual kind of day.
text.plots: Each plot is one block of your day. Do the block and its crop grows; skip it and weeds come.
text.capsule: Tickets come from waking on time and the Night ritual. Spend them here for new seeds.

welcomeBack.title: Welcome back
welcomeBack.som: Som wakes up from a long nap, stretches, and is so glad to see you.
welcomeBack.body: Your farm waited for you: no plant wilted or died while you were away. Pick up from today.
welcomeBack.goalBody: {done} of {need} easy days (I'm up on time + Night ritual) in the next 5 days

ch0_gate.title: Som
ch0_gate.l1: An orange cat is napping by the old gate.
ch0_gate.l2: It stretches, yawns, and looks right at you.
ch0_gate.l3: “Mrrp?” It seems to have been waiting for someone.
ch0_gate.l4: Som follows you in. The farm has a cat now.

ch1_first_harvest.title: First harvest
ch1_first_harvest.l1: Som sniffs your first harvest, very seriously.
ch1_first_harvest.l2: It decides one radish leaf belongs to Som.
ch1_first_harvest.l3: In return, Som brings you a seed it found. Fair trade.

ch2_watering_can.title: Three good days
ch2_watering_can.l1: Som has been rummaging in the old shed.
ch2_watering_can.l2: It drags out a dusty watering can. Your three good days earned it.
ch2_watering_can.l3: The farm feels a little more like home.

ch3_new_friend.title: A new friend
ch3_new_friend.l1: Som stares at the new arrival. Who said anyone else could live here?
ch3_new_friend.l2: It pretends not to care. It cares a lot.
ch3_new_friend.l3: By afternoon they're napping in the same sunny spot.

ch4_sunset.title: Seven days
ch4_sunset.l1: Seven days in a row. Som wants a walk at sunset.
ch4_sunset.l2: The old farm sign has faded. Som sits beside it, meaningfully.
ch4_sunset.l3: Freshly painted. Now everyone knows whose farm this is.

ch5_house.title: Moving in
ch5_house.l1: The farmhouse is ready. Som inspects every corner.
ch5_house.l2: Som tries every cushion and picks the best one.
ch5_house.l3: That cushion is Som's now. You may visit.

ch6_album.title: Thirty days
ch6_album.l1: Thirty days on the farm. Not in a row, and that's fine.
ch6_album.l2: Som has been collecting moments on the wall: mornings, harvests, rainy days.
ch6_album.l3: A whole month of you. Som is proud.

cafe_open.title: Som's café
cafe_open.l1: The farmhouse has a new room, and it smells like coffee.
cafe_open.l2: Som has opened a tiny café. The menu is short and the barista is fluffy.
cafe_open.l3: Order anything, any time. Every cup gets a stamp.

wish.label: Your wish (optional, only you can see it)
wish.placeholder: e.g. pass my exams, sleep before midnight
wish.private: Private · {n, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
wish.error: Couldn't float it right now. Try again?

lotus_open.title: Candle Lotus
lotus_open.l1: Som is staring into the pond, very, very still.
lotus_open.l2: A lotus has opened, and inside it glows a tiny flame.
lotus_open.l3: Som brings you a seed from it. Candle Lotus seeds are in the shop until the 14th.

lotus_market.title: The krathong market
lotus_market.l1: Lanterns on the water: the krathong market is open.
lotus_market.l2: Candle Lotus sells for ×1.5 here until the month ends.
lotus_market.l3: Someone is asking for three Candle Lotus. There's a special order in the market.

lotus_use.title: Float a wish
lotus_use.l1: Som carries your Candle Lotus down to the water.
lotus_use.l2: It's Loy Krathong season. People float their wishes away on the water.
lotus_use.l3: Want to float one too? It's just for you, and you can skip.
lotus_use.l4: Your wish drifts away with its tiny flame. Som will keep it safe until next Loy Krathong.

snow_open.title: Snow Strawberry
snow_open.l1: Mist rolls over the hills. Som's whiskers are cold.
snow_open.l2: Between the leaves: strawberries, white as the mist.
snow_open.l3: Som brings you a seed. Snow Strawberry seeds are in the shop until the 14th.

snow_market.title: The winter-lights market
snow_market.l1: Little lights on a string: the winter market is open.
snow_market.l2: Snow Strawberries sell for more until the end of the month.
snow_market.l3: Som warms its paws by a stall and waits for you.

snow_use.title: The year-end cake
snow_use.l1: Som carries your Snow Strawberry to the kitchen.
snow_use.l2: A year-end cake, with white strawberries on top.
snow_use.l3: Som looks back at your year with you.
snow_use.l4: Here's to next year. Som will be right here.

cafe.askHint: Only so Stats can show whether coffee changes your sleep. Asked once a day at most, only after coffee or tea.

push.askHint: A nudge when a block starts, a first-10 reminder, "I'm up" and the Night ritual. You choose which, and quiet hours.

state.blocked: Notifications are blocked for 24/7. Turn them on in your phone's Settings, then come back.
